notes: Qt 6.12.0; scene graph backend=software; platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped (software: emitted by the software render loop right after QBackingStore::flush of the dirty region to the X window (xcb, MIT-SHM); RHI OpenGL: after the GL swapBuffers of the basic render loop (Mesa llvmpipe)). QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (documented in QWindow::requestUpdate and recommended for benchmarking in the Qt Quick Scene Graph docs; removes the default 5 ms update pacing unless --paced). Pacing BENCH_PACING=60: each tick is scheduled on a fixed 16.667 ms grid by QTimer::singleShot(nanoseconds, Qt::PreciseTimer) (public API, ms accuracy on Linux per Qt::TimerType docs). Continuous redraw: each frameSwapped queues a tick that advances the script and calls QQuickWindow::update(); only frames following a tick are counted. First 2 s warm-up discarded (scripts restart at t=0). Canvas impl=painted (QQuickPaintedItem, renderTarget Image (QPainter raster into a QImage, then drawn by the scene graph)); gradient fill via per-shape QLinearGradient(ObjectBoundingMode), antialiased rounded clip path; drop shadows: QPainter has no blur API, so a pre-blurred sprite (3 box-blur passes approximating an 8 px blur) cached per (type,size) is drawn at offset (2,2) under 1 shape in 10. Graph: 10000-pt drawPolyline.
version: Qt 6.12.0 (runtime 6.12.0, aqtinstall linux_gcc_64 from download.qt.io), g++ 13.3.0, CMake 4.4.4, Ninja 1.13.2
